notes.title: Update v 1.3 – Performance and Localization Fixes
notes.notes:
Significantly optimized loading of game areas

 Performance increased by up to 60% in the most demanding parts of the map

 Fixed minor rendering issues with certain objects in the inventory view

 Fixed localization issues – corrected inaccuracies in Czech texts

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Minor Update


 Fixed some objects
 Fixed sound and volume issues
 Fixed lighting

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.notes:
Fixed areas where the player could get stuck
 Fixed reflection settings in the menu not saving when set to low
 Fixed the display of the first PDA
 Fixed the underground switch that sometimes didn’t respond
 Fixed text errors and typos

notes.title: Hotfix – Version 1.1 (release day)
notes.notes:
Patch notes:


 Fixed message decryption
 Fixed log display issues
 Other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Release Day
notes.notes:
🔧 If you come across any bugs or issues, feel free to report them here – I'm actively working on updates and improvements.
💬 I'm also open to feedback – what do you enjoy, what could be better?
🕹️ If you enjoyed the game and would like to see a sequel in the future, let me know! I'm also happy to hear your suggestions for future improvements or additions.

Thanks for being here – I hope you enjoy the game and have a great time playing it. 🚀
